text: Distribution: PTP (IEEE 1588, power profile IEEE C37.238) for the protection relays and TCS (as offered in TQ-IEC-004: TCS synchronised from the DCS master clock by PTP), NTP for servers and workstations, IRIG-B for recorders; accuracy of 1 ms or better at every time stamping device, and holdover accuracy of 1 ms or better for 24 hours after the loss of GPS.
